scope: Deliver the exact preserved agent-authored Starter optional Automations gate through Work-controlled Preview review; preserve frozen task evidence and retire resolved fresh admission.
riskAnalysis: One customer JavaScript line changes optional request membership only. Supporting historical source/copy/admission changes are security-sensitive: never substitute old evidence for current source, weaken permissions, rewrite receipts or revive grants. Current-source product tests and explicitly historical regression fixtures are separate.

threatModel.assets: Product entitlement behavior, backend authorization, original source/receipt integrity, task/release binding and audit history.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Model-authored line was independently inspected before Work source application. Current source lock and frozen historical source are distinct. Only Work controls publication; internal agents remain proposal-only.
threatModel.abuseCases: Stale source promoted as current, historical task readback reused as fresh authority, forged patch binding, arbitrary old preimage, cross-workspace change, hidden real plan mutation in QA, false acceptance.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact original file and five receipt hashes, one unique replacement, current-only source/task guard, explicit task retirement, immutable asset hash check for historical copies, unchanged bounded patch grammar/authorization/cancellation, separate current-product tests, fictional restored browser state and no provider writes.

defects.rootCause: The optional fallback feed array always included Automations although Starter lacks the feature and the account endpoint denies it.
defects.detectionGap: Prior loader coverage modeled calendar entitlement but not Automations entitlement.
defects.regression: Starter/Growth/Pro matrix, upgrades/downgrades, exact handler preservation, unrelated failure/retry, loading/sync timestamps and rendered fictional fallback/bundled checks.
defects.historicalPrevention: Preserve exact real model proposal and Auditor rejection; Work adds missing impact/context/verification without relabeling old review.

defects.rootCause: Historical implementation source and draft receipt validation were coupled to the live dashboard file, preventing safe current product advancement.
defects.detectionGap: Earlier integration cases ran only while the fixed task baseline equaled current product source.
defects.regression: Immutable source fixture replay, old/current evidence readback tests, exact historical copy hash and original source untouched, current actual task denial before journal append and readable disabled owner readiness.
defects.historicalPrevention: Keep original assets/requests immutable, v4 readback-only, current v5 pinned independently; never use historical source as default current-source admission.

defects.rootCause: A one-second dispatch-window fixture spent its dispatch allowance during unrelated setup under local CPU load.
defects.detectionGap: Setup and wall cancellation timing were mixed.
defects.regression: Freeze only authorization Date.now consistently; retain real one-second cancellation timers, real cleanup duration under10s, exact count/no-response/revocation checks and all separate expiry cases.
defects.historicalPrevention: Preserve earlier flaky-test repair and production time/lease code unchanged; name evidence as cancellation timing rather than wall-clock expiry proof.

rollback: Revert this reviewed feature branch batch if verification fails; preserve original model receipts, rejected review, historical assets and financial uncertainty. No Production rollback, grant restoration or paid retry.
